d: A three-storey under-construction building collapsed in Old Delhi’s Chawri Bazaar area on Thursday morning, leaving at least two people dead and up to several others feared trapped under the rubble. The Delhi Fire Services received the initial call at 9:50 AM from Gali Sitara, located close to the Chawri Bazaar Metro station. Joint rescue operations involving the NDRF, Delhi Fire Services, Delhi Police, and local administration remain underway at the site. This incident occurs just two months after a similar building collapse in West Delhi's Satya Niketan claimed seven lives. Watch
